classification.difficultyReason: Find successive unknowns by combining algebraic angle equations, reflex complements and supplementary relationships.

content.prompt: Determine the value of each pronumeral.

spec.description: A descending diagonal crosses a gently rising line. Upper sector a and adjacent right sector b have ordinary arcs. A blue reflex arc runs from the upper-left diagonal ray around the left and bottom to the rightward ray, including sector b, and is labelled 200°.
spec.mathematics: a + 200 = 360 and a + b = 180. The source sketch is not metrically consistent with its stated angles; preserve the constraint and topology.
spec.answerVisibility: Only a, b and the supplied 200° constraint appear.

answer.worked:
Angles at a point sum to $360^\circ$.
$$\begin{align*}a+200&=360\\a&=160^\circ\end{align*}$$
Angles on a straight line sum to $180^\circ$.
$$\begin{align*}a+b&=180\\160+b&=180\\b&=20^\circ\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Two gently descending parallel lines cross a rising transversal. Upper-right sectors are labelled 2x + 10 and 75°. The lower intersection also has the adjacent lower-right sector labelled 3y. Matching arrows include the inventory-recorded approved addition on the lower line.
spec.answerVisibility: Givens only; solved x and y excluded.

answer.worked:
Corresponding angles on parallel lines are equal.
$$\begin{align*}2x+10&=75\\2x&=65\\x&=32.5^\circ\end{align*}$$
Angles on a straight line sum to $180^\circ$.
$$\begin{align*}3y+75&=180\\3y&=105\\y&=35^\circ\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Two steep rising parallel lines cross a descending transversal. At the left intersection the right obtuse sector is (4x + 10)° and the bottom acute sector is y. At the right intersection a leader connects the external (2x + 5)° label to the upper acute sector.
spec.answerVisibility: Unknown expressions and source leader only.

answer.worked:
Co-interior angles on parallel lines sum to $180^\circ$.
$$\begin{align*}(4x+10)+(2x+5)&=180\\6x+15&=180\\6x&=165\\x&=27.5^\circ\end{align*}$$
Angles on a straight line sum to $180^\circ$.
$$\begin{align*}y+(4x+10)&=180\\y+(4\times27.5+10)&=180\\y+120&=180\\y&=60^\circ\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Two gently descending parallel lines cross a steep descending transversal. Lower-right corresponding sectors are (6x − 8)° and (2x + 20)°. The lower-left adjacent obtuse sector at the lower intersection is 3y.
spec.answerVisibility: Givens only; retain exact mixed-number answer in answer content.

answer.worked:
Corresponding angles on parallel lines are equal.
$$\begin{align*}6x-8&=2x+20\\4x-8&=20\\4x&=28\\x&=7^\circ\end{align*}$$
Angles on a straight line sum to $180^\circ$.
$$\begin{align*}3y+(2x+20)&=180\\3y+(2\times7+20)&=180\\3y+34&=180\\3y&=146\\y&=\frac{146}{3}^\circ\\y&=48\frac{2}{3}^\circ\end{align*}$$
